ns2:course.label: History of Theatre II
ns2:course.description: History of the drama and theatre of the Spanish Renaissance, seventeenth-century France, the English Restoration, the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries in Europe and America, and Asia. Prerequisite: THEA 360 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: THEA 360 or consent of instructor.
